comment: Four of the nine knobs have a CV jack, all through the same knobCV helper as scando's: a fifth of the voltage added to the knob and clamped to 0..1, so ±5V covers the whole knob. Stiff, shape, force, res and mix have no jack. The band gains are the string's displacement sampled at sixteen points, and because displacement is bipolar a band can come out inverted. The panel prints lustro, stiff, damp, rate, shape, force, res, base, spread, mix, then damp, rate, base and spread over the CV jacks, and excite, exc, in and out.
